title: Scale sprint: one-million-requests readiness canvas
content:
Purpose:
Quick working canvas to verify product + ops readiness for a scale sprint target: sustained ~1,000,000 inference requests/day (bursty distribution). Focus: launch gating KPIs, minimal staffing rota, contingency triggers, quick sim inputs. This is an iterative checklist (working notes).

Assumptions (pre-sprint):
- Target load: 1M requests/day peak shape = 20% morning, 50% afternoon plateau, 30% evening spike (90th percentile burst windows).
- Median request size: 120 tokens output, 40 tokens input.
- Primary model family: open-llama-70B-quant2 variant; fallback variants: 13B-quant (cost-saver), hosted-rtx-fp16 (premium).
- Dedicated pool purchase planned: 12 x A10G equiv (estimate) -> refine via infra sim.

Core gating KPIs (table, informal):
KPI | Target | Current (baseline) | Owner | Hard trigger | Mitigation
- RPS sustained (5m avg) | 1200 rps | 180 rps | Ethan L. | >= 900 rps sustained for 15m -> open incident | scale up dedicated pool, redirect non-critical traffic to 13B fallback
- 99th latency (inference only) | <= 750 ms | 420 ms | Priya N. | > 1.2s -> degrade non-essential features, enable KV-prefix caching | automatic KV caching + canary rollback
- Error rate (HTTP 5xx) | < 0.5% | 0.12% | Gabe O. | > 1% 5m window -> throttle, switch to fallback model | circuit-breaker + gradual rollout backoff
- Cost per 1k tokens (approx) | <= $0.60 | $0.42 | Mariana P. | trending > $0.90 M-o-M -> pause non-critical experiments | force-quantized routes + cache reuse
- Model-QA drift (sampled) | pass 95% guard tests | 98% | Selina P. | < 95% -> hold release | run prompt-safety QA set, rollback variant
- Observability coverage | traces + token meter for 95% of requests | 78% traced | Ethan L. | < 85% traced -> blind spots | instrument lightweight tracing shim

Readiness checklist (operational steps, tick boxes):
- [ ] Capacity commit signed (finance) for dedicated pool + burst buffer (owner: Mariana) -> finance PR: JIRA-FIN-790
- [ ] Infra playbook updated with autoscale policies and emergency-modes (owner: Gabe) -> ensure grace period 30s to scale decisions
- [ ] Runbook: three outage scenarios (GPU OOM, Model-compile regression, Region outage) with on-call steps (owner: Priya)
- [ ] Canary rollout window scheduled (2 hours) + rollback guard rails (owner: Product PM)
- [ ] Cost-monitor alerts configured (daily burn + projection) with paging to finance-oncall
- [ ] Eval prompt set locked and smoke-run executed (owner: Selina)
- [ ] Load test vectors and genesis script checked into repo (owner: Infra SRE)
- [ ] Stakeholder readout + go/no-go at T-48h scheduled (attendees: Eng, SRE, Product Ops, CS)

Staffing & shifts (minimal skeleton):
- Day 0 (launch day): 08:00-20:00 core war room (2 eng infra, 1 model owner, 1 product ops, 1 CS escalation)
- Overnight: skeleton on-call (1 SRE + 1 model on-call); escalation to lead at paging threshold
- Rotation notes: pair product ops + model-owner for first 6 hours to watch QA telemetry
- Slack channel: #scale-sprint-1m (pinned resources: runbook, quick-links, escalation matrix)

Capacity plan (quick numbers for sizing sim):
- Avg tokens/day = 1,000,000 * (40+120) ~ 160M tokens/day -> ~5B tokens/month (billable)
- Expected GPU seconds per request = model-dependent; baseline measured ~0.45s/request on A10G equiv -> need ~125k GPU-seconds/day -> map to cluster sizing (12 GPUs * 24h = 1,036,800s -> plenty headroom; but concurrency, prep, memory matter)
- Cache hit assumptions: with prefix caching expected 25-35% token savings in steady traffic windows

Risk matrix (quick):
- High risk: model-compile regression during canary -> mitigation: freeze kernel set, use compiled snapshot
- Medium risk: cost overrun from telemetry gap -> mitigation: hard-budget throttle route
- Low risk: minor QA drift -> mitigation: prompt-safety auto-ban + degrade to 13B fallback

What-if simulations (notes for infra):
- What-if 1: 2x burst over 10m (equiv ~2400 rps) -> expected queuing -> if 99p latency > 2s, auto-throttle non-auth traffic, enable best-effort-mode which serves 13B only
- What-if 2: single-region outage -> route 60% traffic to other region (cross-region capacity must be pre-warmed), 40% gracefully degraded
- What-if 3: KV cache corruption event -> flush and rebuild with prioritized prefixes; estimate re-warm time 45m -> pre-warm keys for 24h window

Data & observation plan:
- Sampling: store 1% full request+response trace (PII scrubbed) and 100% token-meter metrics
- QA sampling cadence: run 500 golden prompts hourly across canary and baseline models
- Daily readout metrics: RPS 5m avg, 95p latency, 99p latency, error rate, cost/day, top-5 failing prompts

Open questions / TODOs (working):
- Cost model sensitivity: what is expected price change if 13B fallback used for 30% of traffic? (action: finance + infra to run calc) -> JIRA-FIN-790
- Should customer-facing feature flags be pre-armed for immediate toggle? (prod engineers)
- Confirm KMS access for private-deploy customers during cross-region reroute (security)
- Need final sign-off on staffing budget from head of ops by 2025-10-01

Immediate next steps (owners):
- Mariana: finalize capacity commit and confirm finance PR (due: 2025-09-18)
- Gabe: push infra autoscale PR and run baseline load 2x (due: 2025-09-20)
- Priya: write the 3 outage run scenarios and attach to runbook (due: 2025-09-22)
- Selina: lock eval set and run smoke QA across all fallback routes (due: 2025-09-21)
- Ethan: instrument missing trace points and re-run cost projection (due: 2025-09-19)

Notes-to-self / informal: 
- keep this sheet lean; move polished runbook to Confluence once items stabilized.
- during dry-run, record a short clip of traffic shift (helps onboarding).

Revision history (short):
- 2025-09-12: created initial canvas (Mariana)
- 2025-09-19: added staffing rota and sim numbers (Ethan)
- 2025-10-03: updated gating KPIs and linked artifacts (Mariana)

End of working canvas.
